entries.title: Isaiah 32:1
segments: ¶Behold, a king will reign in righteousness, And princes will rule with justice.

entries.title: Isaiah 32:2
segments: A man will be as a hiding place from the wind, And a cover from the tempest, As rivers of water in a dry place, As the shadow of a great rock in a weary land.

entries.title: Isaiah 32:3
segments: The eyes of those who see will not be dim, And the ears of those who hear will listen.

entries.title: Isaiah 32:4
segments: Also the heart of the rash will understand knowledge, And the tongue of the stammerers will be ready to speak plainly.

entries.title: Isaiah 32:5
segments: The foolish person will no longer be called generous, Nor the miser said [to be] bountiful;

entries.title: Isaiah 32:6
segments: For the foolish person will speak foolishness, And his heart will work iniquity: To practice ungodliness, To utter error against the LORD, To keep the hungry unsatisfied, And he will cause the drink of the thirsty to fail.

entries.title: Isaiah 32:7
segments: Also the schemes of the schemer [are] evil; He devises wicked plans To destroy the poor with lying words, Even when the needy speaks justice.

entries.title: Isaiah 32:8
segments: But a generous man devises generous things, And by generosity he shall stand.

entries.title: Isaiah 32:9
segments: ¶Rise up, you women who are at ease, Hear my voice; You complacent daughters, Give ear to my speech.

entries.title: Isaiah 32:10
segments: In a year and [some] days You will be troubled, you complacent women; For the vintage will fail, The gathering will not come.

entries.title: Isaiah 32:11
segments: Tremble, you [women] who are at ease; Be troubled, you complacent ones; Strip yourselves, make yourselves bare, And gird [sackcloth] on [your] waists.

entries.title: Isaiah 32:12
segments: People shall mourn upon their breasts For the pleasant fields, for the fruitful vine.

entries.title: Isaiah 32:13
segments: On the land of my people will come up thorns [and] briers, Yes, on all the happy homes [in] the joyous city;

entries.title: Isaiah 32:14
segments: Because the palaces will be forsaken, The bustling city will be deserted. The forts and towers will become lairs forever, A joy of wild donkeys, a pasture of flocks-

entries.title: Isaiah 32:15
segments: Until the Spirit is poured upon us from on high, And the wilderness becomes a fruitful field, And the fruitful field is counted as a forest.

entries.title: Isaiah 32:16
segments: Then justice will dwell in the wilderness, And righteousness remain in the fruitful field.

entries.title: Isaiah 32:17
segments: The work of righteousness will be peace, And the effect of righteousness, quietness and assurance forever.

entries.title: Isaiah 32:18
segments: My people will dwell in a peaceful habitation, In secure dwellings, and in quiet resting places,

entries.title: Isaiah 32:19
segments: Though hail comes down on the forest, And the city is brought low in humiliation.

entries.title: Isaiah 32:20
segments: Blessed [are] you who sow beside all waters, Who send out freely the feet of the ox and the donkey.
